const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""RoboTwin 2.0 move_stapler_pad controller (eai-standard/2.1)."""
+import argparse
+import json
+import pathlib
+import sys
+
+import numpy as np
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot, EpisodeOver
+
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/output")
+SOURCE = np.array([-0.113, -0.043])
+PAD = np.array([-0.105, -0.147])
+# Rotates the gripper approach axis (local +x) downward; fingers close along world y.
+DOWN = np.array([2**-0.5, 0.0, 2**-0.5, 0.0], dtype=np.float32)
+
+
+def observe(robot):
+    return robot.get_obs(cameras=("head_camera", "front_camera", "observer_camera",
+                                  "left_camera", "right_camera"), video="none")
+
+
+def ee_command(robot, obs, xyz, quat, grip):
+    now = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=np.float32)
+    left = np.r_[np.asarray(xyz, dtype=np.float32), np.asarray(quat, dtype=np.float32), np.float32(grip)]
+    right = np.r_[now[21:28], now[29]]
+    return robot.submit("ee_pose", np.r_[left, right], video="both", video_fps=10,
+                        cameras=("head_camera", "front_camera", "observer_camera", "left_camera", "right_camera"))
+
+
+def gripper_command(robot, obs, left_value):
+    now = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=np.float32)
+    row = now[:14].copy()
+    row[6] = left_value
+    # A short stream gives the gripper time to finish while both arms hold position.
+    return robot.submit("joint_position", np.repeat(row[None, :], 20, axis=0), dt=0.05,
+                        video="both", video_fps=10,
+                        cameras=("head_camera", "front_camera", "observer_camera", "left_camera", "right_camera"))
+
+
+def run_stage(robot, stage):
+    obs = observe(robot)
+    now = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=np.float32)
+    p = now[14:21].copy()
+    if stage == "pregrasp":
+        res = ee_command(robot, obs, [SOURCE[0], SOURCE[1], 1.02], DOWN, 1.0)
+    elif stage == "descend":
+        res = ee_command(robot, obs, [SOURCE[0], SOURCE[1], 0.90], DOWN, 1.0)
+    elif stage == "close":
+        res = gripper_command(robot, obs, 0.0)
+    elif stage == "lift":
+        res = ee_command(robot, obs, [p[0], p[1], 1.02], DOWN, 0.0)
+    elif stage == "transfer":
+        res = ee_command(robot, obs, [PAD[0], PAD[1], 1.02], DOWN, 0.0)
+    elif stage == "lower":
+        res = ee_command(robot, obs, [PAD[0], PAD[1], 0.90], DOWN, 0.0)
+    elif stage == "release":
+        res = gripper_command(robot, obs, 1.0)
+    elif stage == "retreat":
+        res = ee_command(robot, obs, [p[0], p[1], 1.02], DOWN, 1.0)
+    else:
+        raise ValueError(stage)
+    print(json.dumps({"stage": stage, "meta": res.meta}, indent=2))
+    if res.last:
+        res.save(str(OUT / f"{stage}_result"))
+    return res
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--stage", choices=("pregrasp", "descend", "close", "lift", "transfer",
+                                             "lower", "release", "retreat"))
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    robot = Robot(timeout=240)
+    print("spec", json.dumps({"protocol": robot.spec().get("protocol"),
+                              "budgets": robot.spec().get("budgets")}, indent=2))
+    stages = [args.stage] if args.stage else ["pregrasp", "descend", "close", "lift", "transfer", "lower", "release", "retreat"]
+    for stage in stages:
+        result = run_stage(robot, stage)
+        if result.done:
+            print("episode done", result.meta.get("reason"))
+            break
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    try:
+        main()
+    except EpisodeOver as exc:
+        print("episode over:", exc)
*** End Patch";
const r = await tools.apply_patch(patch);
text(r);
